// Dijkstra's on the horse/bees map - generated by Claude for Topic 9B Task 2
// Weights: 1 = grass, 5 = edge touching a bee square (B, D, E, I, J)
var edges = new (string From, string To, int Weight)[]
{
    ("END", "L", 1), ("L", "I", 5), ("I", "F", 5), ("F", "C", 1), ("C", "A", 1),
    ("M", "J", 5), ("J", "G", 5), ("G", "D", 5), ("D", "Start", 5),
    ("N", "K", 1), ("K", "H", 1), ("H", "E", 5), ("E", "B", 5),
    ("L", "M", 1), ("M", "N", 1), ("I", "J", 5), ("J", "K", 5),
    ("F", "G", 1), ("G", "H", 1), ("C", "D", 5), ("D", "E", 5),
    ("A", "Start", 1), ("Start", "B", 5),
};

// adjacency list: node name -> list of (neighbour, weight)
var graph = new Dictionary<string, List<(string Node, int Weight)>>();
foreach (var (from, to, weight) in edges)
{
    AddDirected(from, to, weight);
    AddDirected(to, from, weight);
}

var (path, cost) = Dijkstra(graph, "Start", "END");
Console.WriteLine(path is null ? "No path found." : $"Path: {string.Join(" -> ", path)}");
Console.WriteLine($"Total cost: {cost}");

void AddDirected(string from, string to, int weight)
{
    if (!graph.TryGetValue(from, out var list))
    {
        list = new List<(string, int)>();
        graph[from] = list;
    }
    list.Add((to, weight));
}

static (List<string>? Path, int Cost) Dijkstra(
    Dictionary<string, List<(string Node, int Weight)>> graph, string start, string goal)
{
    var dist = new Dictionary<string, int> { [start] = 0 };
    var prev = new Dictionary<string, string>();
    var visited = new HashSet<string>();
    var pq = new PriorityQueue<string, int>();
    pq.Enqueue(start, 0);

    while (pq.TryDequeue(out var current, out var d))
    {
        // skip stale queue entries for nodes we've already finalised
        if (!visited.Add(current))
        {
            continue;
        }
        if (current == goal)
        {
            break;
        }

        foreach (var (next, w) in graph[current])
        {
            int nd = d + w;
            if (!dist.TryGetValue(next, out var old) || nd < old)
            {
                dist[next] = nd;
                prev[next] = current;
                pq.Enqueue(next, nd);
            }
        }
    }

    if (!dist.ContainsKey(goal))
    {
        return (null, -1);
    }

    var path = new List<string>();
    for (var at = goal; ; at = prev[at])
    {
        path.Add(at);
        if (at == start)
        {
            break;
        }
    }
    path.Reverse();
    return (path, dist[goal]);
}
